# Enable the Bluetooth subsystem and required host/controller layers
CONFIG_BT=y
CONFIG_BT_HOST=y
CONFIG_BT_HCI=y

# Enable the full BLE Mesh stack required for operation
CONFIG_BT_MESH=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_PROV=y          # provisioning support
CONFIG_BT_MESH_RELAY=y         # relay functionality

# Optional: GATT Proxy (useful for provisioning over GATT)
CONFIG_BT_MESH_GATT_PROXY=y

# Ensure Mesh Friend and Low Power are NOT both enabled (mutually exclusive)
CONFIG_BT_MESH_FRIEND=n
CONFIG_BT_MESH_LOW_POWER=n

# Additional dependencies commonly required for Mesh on native_sim
CONFIG_BT_SETTINGS=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS=y
CONFIG_SETTINGS_RUNTIME=y
